prompt: tell me a good itenarary for spending a day in london, I want to have the best views this time of the year and also have the best food available
response: Start your day with a visit to the Shard for panoramic views of London, especially beautiful in the morning light. For lunch, head to Borough Market, known for its fresh and diverse food options, especially the famous street food scene. In the afternoon, explore the Tate Modern, and for dinner, enjoy a Michelin-starred restaurant in the City for the best culinary experience.
